principle: The seed of the 'Cognition → Deterministic Replacement' knowledge graph: IF an execution trace shows <pattern> THEN try <optimization passes>. These are CANDIDATE heuristics (serves_truth=false) — the explicit, hand-seeded layer; the descent brain (descent_attempt_store) learns + scores more from real per-step traces over time (the trace-telemetry gap is filed). Each heuristic references real passes (optimization_passes.json) + archetypes (inefficient_pipeline_archetypes.json). The optimizer/supervisor proposes; nothing auto-applies without the validation sandbox + guardrails.

heuristics.when: document_size > 40 pages AND whole doc sent to an LLM
heuristics.rationale: isolate the few relevant pages before any LLM

heuristics.when: an identical API call sequence repeats > 500 times
actions: replace LLM planning with a static workflow DAG
heuristics.rationale: a fixed sequence needs no re-planning

heuristics.when: the same reasoning prompt repeats frequently with stable outputs
heuristics.rationale: distill repeated reasoning into a deterministic rule (from VERIFIED outcomes; lossless)

actions: replace visual reasoning with a Playwright/Selenium script (DOM/XPath)
heuristics.rationale: a stable UI path is deterministic

heuristics.when: a frontier model is used for low-entropy classification/routing
actions: route only the ambiguous residual to a model
heuristics.rationale: most routing is decidable without a frontier model

heuristics.when: retrieval stuffs many low-relevance chunks into the prompt
heuristics.rationale: fewer, better chunks beat more tokens

heuristics.when: a search/research loop has no stop condition
a multimodal model is used for a simple visual check
actions: a small detector (YOLO) for known objects
heuristics.rationale: deterministic CV handles the common case
a stable plan should be cached, not re-derived

heuristics.when: an LLM parses a structured/semi-structured format (PDF tables, JSON, CSV)
